description_en: Pushes a message to devices. Two message types are supported: pass-through and notification
description_zh: 推送消息到设备端，支持透传、通知两种消息类型
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc push-message --app-package com.aliyun.iovcc.cmns.test --act com.aliyun.iovcc.action --pkg-content package_:_com.aliyun.iovcc.cmns.test --receiver-type uuid --receiver-values b81d39b0252a4ffdb750360b262cb442,_b81d39b0252a4ffdb750360b262cb411 --project-id sfgsghd6 --app-key com.aliyun.aicc.test --type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PushMessage

parameters.help_en: The package name of the client application to which the message belongs
parameters.help_zh: 消息归属客户端应用包名
parameters.name: app_package

parameters.help_en: The notification content details. This parameter is required when the message type is notification
parameters.help_zh: 通知内容详情，消息类型为通知时必传
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en: The broadcast listening channel, which is configured by agreement between the client and the server
parameters.help_zh: 广播侦听通道，为客户端与服务端约定配置
parameters.name: act

parameters.help_en: This parameter is specific to AliOS 4.0. This parameter is required for notification and pass-through messages on AliOS devices
parameters.help_zh: alios4.0专用，alios设备通知和透传消息时必传
parameters.name: uri

parameters.help_en: The Android intent property value parameter. The value is a JSON string. You can set the following five intent property keys: "component", "uri", "type", "package", and "category"
parameters.help_zh: android intent属性值参数，为json字符串，用户可选择设置"component"，"uri"，"type"，"package"，"category"等5个intent属性key
parameters.name: pkg_content

parameters.help_en:
The custom content defined by the user.

The value is a JSON string. The keyword "cmns" must not be used as a field in the JSON string. This parameter is required when the message type is pass-through (type=1)
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义内容。

为json字符串，json字符串中不得使用关键字"cmns"作为字段，消息类型为透传（type=1）时必传
parameters.name: custom_content

parameters.help_en:
The message accept object type. Valid values: uuid, imei, kp, and terminal.

To send messages by device dimension, set this parameter to uuid or imei.
To send messages by account dimension, set this parameter to kp.
To send messages by device type dimension, set this parameter to terminal
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收对象类型。取值："uuid"、"imei"、"kp"、"terminal"。

按设备维度发送时，选择uuid或者imei。
按账号维度发送时，选择kp。
按设备类型维度时，选择terminal
parameters.name: receiver_type

parameters.help_en:
The values of the message recipients. Separate multiple recipients with commas (,).

When using uuid or imei values, a maximum of 1000 devices are supported.
When using kp values, a maximum of 100 accounts are supported.
When using terminal values, a maximum of 10 device models are supported
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收对象值，多个接收对象通过英文逗号拼接。

按照uuid或者imei的值拼接，最多限制1000个设备。
按照kp的值拼接，最多限制100个账号。
按照terminal的值拼接，最多限制10个机型
parameters.name: receiver_values

parameters.help_en:
The message expiration time.

This is a relative time value (the number of seconds before the message expires). The maximum value is 7 days for unicast messages and 30 days for broadcast messages. Unit: seconds. Default value: 3600 (1 hour)
parameters.help_zh:
消息过期时间。

相对时间（即多少秒后过期，单发最多7天，群发消息最多不能超过30天），单位为S，默认1小时过期
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The notification title. This parameter is required when the message type is notification
parameters.help_zh: 通知标题，消息类型为通知时必传
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:
1: pass-through message.
2: notification
parameters.help_zh: 消息类型。取值：1表示透传消息，2表示通知
parameters.name: type
